Name: Neuropixels recordings in anesthetized rats (saline vs. LSD) with intracranial electrical stimulation
Description: Neuropixels 1.0 recordings from medial prefrontal cortex in seven anesthetized Sprague-Dawley rats (3 LSD, 4 saline), 24 hours after administration of 0.2 mg/kg LSD or saline (vehicle), with electrical stimulation delivered to the basolateral amygdala (BLA). Raw data are provided under sourcedata/; Kilosort4 spike sorting and bombcell quality metrics are provided under derivatives/.
